To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel approach to transfer representations from one DNN model to another, which is based on an auto-routing scheme that automatically learns to transfer the most relevant representations to the target DNN.
we propose a new knowledge transfer approach that automatically routes the source representations to the appropriate target representations, which leads to improved accuracy.
we propose a novel adversarially trained auto-transfer scheme that automatically learns to combine source representations with target representations to produce more accurate target models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of knowledge transfer between heterogeneous networks and tasks.
the question: How to automatically learn to route source representations for transfer to a target network?
the question of how to automatically learn to combine source and target features in a manner that produces the most accurate target model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose a novel adversarially learned routing scheme for transferable representations that outperforms state-of-the-art methods by upwards of 5% on four image classification benchmarks.
our method is able to automatically learn to route source representations into target representations in a way that produces more effective transfer of information than existing methods.
we propose a novel adversarially trained multi-armed bandits based knowledge transfer method that learns to route source features to target features in a way that produces the best target models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach is the first of its kind to learn to route source representations for transfer to target networks.
our approach learns to transfer source representations in a way that the target network is able to learn better and faster.

we propose an effective method to route representations between source and target networks that can improve performance of the target networks by 5\% over the state-of-the art knowledge transfer approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can learn to route source features to target features in an automatic fashion that is more effective than existing approaches.
the source and target networks can be different and the source network does not need to constrain the target network in any way.
the source features can be automatically routed and combined in meaningful ways with target features to obtain accurate target models.
